articles.title: You Can Watch a Real Deep-Sea Mission Live Right Now!
articles.summary: A robot is diving 3.5 miles down in the Pacific Ocean, and you can watch it live today! The NOAA ship Okeanos is exploring near the Cook Islands. Tune in at 5:30 p.m. EDT to see deep-sea creatures and help scientists learn.

articles.title: Scientists Find New Clues to Fight Alzheimer's Disease
articles.summary: Scientists made two new chemical tools that can help study a protein linked to Alzheimer's. One tool turns the protein on, the other turns it off. This could help find a cure for the disease that affects millions of people.

articles.title: Neptune's Moons Might Be Leftovers from a Giant Crash!
articles.summary: Scientists think three of Neptune's moons were born from a huge collision. Neptune's biggest moon, Triton, may have smashed into other moons, and the pieces came together to form new ones. The James Webb Space Telescope found clay minerals that support this idea.
